note: Simulations and offline comparisons behind the choice of the move-based rating (5 October 2026). Simulated users are the calibrated player at a target strength, or the strong player's best move ('best'). Elo values are means over the stated number of runs.

estimator_vs_fixed_bot.what: Whole-game Elo estimator, uncorrected: estimate of the user (white) after 20 moves against a bot of fixed strength; 5 games per cell.

move_rating_vs_fixed_bot.what: Move-based rating, uncorrected: estimate of the user (white) after 20 moves against a bot of fixed strength; 4 games per cell.

estimator_closed_loop.what: Whole-game Elo estimator, uncorrected, with the bot following the estimate: combined result of 3 games of 30 moves; 3 sessions per cell. Policies: the bot re-targets every move / is fixed during a game / moves 10% of the way per move.

move_rating_closed_loop.what: Move-based rating with the bot following it every move: combined result after 1 and 2 games of up to 30 moves; 6 sessions per target.

variants.what: Variants of the move-based rating on 3,300 real test players, uncorrected: mean absolute error (Elo) after 10 / 20 / 40 own moves, and the 90th percentile of the error after 20.

rows.name: with a cap of 4 nats per move (used)
